clauses.reason: The sole paragraph deletes the text of section 602(d)(2) of Executive Order 10480, which EO 12521 had added, and inserts a provision authorizing the Bureau of Economic Analysis of the United States Department of Commerce as central collecting agency to collect the information for the reports to Congress required by section 309 of the Defense Production Act. Executive Order 12919 of June 3, 1994 provides in section 904: "(a) The following are superseded or revoked:" and lists "(10) Executive Order No. 12649 of August 11, 1988 (53 FR 30639).". That names this order and revokes or supersedes it. EO 12919 contains no effective-date wording for section 904, so the first-end date is its signing date, 1994-06-03; this is a reading of the text and not express wording.
